rule_gaps: CAT_RULES matches "ring" as a SUBSTRING of the shop breadcrumb, so Rengjøring / Skismøring / frikjøring / O-ring send buckets, cleaning cloths, ski wax and a touring binding to Jewelry (and derive facet type "Rings") — that rule needs a word boundary

"sølv"/"gull" in a product NAME is usually a COLOUR (Fujifilm GFX100RF Sølv, Kakebrett Sølv, bilderamme - Sølv, folieballong i gull, Sølvgrå glidelås, brand "Gullugso") — the metal words must not classify on their own when the breadcrumb says Rammer/Home/Sy og Strikk/Kjøkken

Norwegian flatware vocabulary is unmapped (skje, gaffel, øse, ostehøvel, laksespade, flaskeåpner), so Mestergull's silver cutlery lands on a Jewelry floor behind its unreadable "Hjem > Produkter" breadcrumb — 12 rows here
"Halsbånd" is a dog collar in a pet shop and a necklace in a jeweller; the Zooservice floor should beat the necklace vocabulary

craft/beading components (charms, fjærlås, smykkelås, anheng blanks, perlesett) from Tegne.no and Panduro classify as Jewelry; a "Sy og Strikk"/"Hobby" crumb or those shops' floors should route to Hobby
no facetrule turns "smykke" + a *kjeder breadcrumb into type Necklaces, or "-ring"/"Charms"/"medaljong" into Rings / Pendants & charms — ~30 rows here carry material and stone but no type
bunadsølv words (sølje, halsknapp, capespenne, hårspenne, heng) derive no type at all; a "Brooches & pins" rule over that vocabulary would fill ~25 rows (not filed per-row here)
notes: The real jewellery (byBiehl, Bjørklund, By Olea, Dima, Duette, Sylvsmidja bunadsølv) is in good shape — right category, sane brands, sane prices; 67 of the 300 rows are not jewellery at all and reach Jewelry through two mechanical faults: the substring "ring" inside Rengjøring/Skismøring, and silver/gold used as a colour word. 17 unwired variant families (ring sizes and finishes) inflate the listing, one exact cross-shop duplicate needs an alias, and 149 rows still have no product photo. One material and one stone value are outright wrong; ~9 "gullfarget stål" rows store material "Gold plated" where the base metal is steel — left unfiled as a judgement call.
